project_name: Market Pulse NSE - Indian Stock Scanner & Signal Dashboard
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Obsidian Command-Center)
file_extension_note: CRITICAL: The codebase uses JavaScript (.js and .jsx) files. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) extensions.

forbidden_patterns: Flat gray dark overlays without borders

header.style: bg-[#090A0F]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#232736] px-4 py-2.5 z-40 sticky top-0 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Brand Logo: MarketPulse NSE with animated live pulse indicator (green dot)
Indices Ticker Strip: NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, SENSEX, INDIA VIX with live change badge
Navigation Tabs: Pulse (Overview), Signals (Scanner), Watchlist, Market News
Market Status Badge: OPEN / CLOSED with live clock (IST)
Quick Search Command Bar (Nifty 200 stocks instant lookup)

layout_and_navigation.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Command Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4)
layout_and_navigation.responsive_rules: Mobile-first grid collapse, drawer sliders for stock deep-dive on mobile and desktop

ticker_strip.container: bg-[#0D0F17] border-b border-[#1E2230] py-2 px-4 overflow-x-auto flex items-center gap-6 text-xs font-mono

market_breath_gauge.style: High-density ratio bar showing Advances vs Declines on Nifty 200 (e.g., 132 Bullish / 68 Bearish)
market_breath_gauge.visual: Dual-tone bar with indicator needle & market mood badge (Extremely Bullish / Neutral / Bearish)

signal_scanner_table.style: Dense tabular grid with sticky headers, color-coded RSI & MACD divergence alerts
filters: Signal Type: Bullish RSI Divergence, Bearish RSI Divergence, MACD Bullish Crossover, MACD Bearish Crossover

sector_heatmap.style: Treemap/Grid of Nifty Sectors (IT, Banking, Auto, Pharma, FMCG, Metal, Energy) colored by average gain/loss strength

stock_detail_drawer.component: Side Drawer / Modal with Recharts candlestick/area price graph, RSI momentum line, MACD histogram, and key technical indicators (20 EMA, 50 SMA, 52W High/Low)

watchlist_page.style: LocalStorage powered customizable watchlist grid with quick-remove, target alerts, and signal summaries

news_feed.style: Real-time market news stream aggregated from CNBC-TV18, Moneycontrol, ET Markets, Yahoo Finance RSS feeds with source filtering tags

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and data-displaying elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build a high-frequency trading command center UI specifically for Indian stock traders (NSE Nifty 200).

2. Connect with backend FastAPI endpoints that fetch live/delayed quotes or fallback seamlessly to realistic calculated mock data with real Yahoo Finance symbol formats (e.g. RELIANCE.NS, TCS.NS, INFY.NS, HDFCBANK.NS).
3. Implement live RSI (Relative Strength Index) calculation and MACD (12, 26, 9) signal engine for 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m timeframes.
4. Ensure tab switching between Pulse, Signals, Watchlist, News is instant with URL parameter or state sync.
5. Use LocalStorage for saving user Watchlist stocks persistently without login requirement.
6. Use Sonner toasts to notify user when adding/removing stocks from Watchlist or triggering a scanner alert test.
7. Include comprehensive data-testid attributes on all buttons, table rows, filter tabs, inputs, and indicators.
